definition_en: a wide street in a town, or a way of reaching a goal
core_image: 两侧栽满树的宽阔街道，一直通向前方
scene: 清晨的街道很安静。 A wide avenue runs from the station to the park.
sceneCN: 这里 avenue 是「大街」（第 1 个义项：城市里的宽阔道路）；句意是一条宽阔的大街从车站一直通到公园。

derivatives.zh: 同源词，con-（共同）加 venire（来），义为「召集；集会」
同源词，inter-（之间）加 venire（来），义为「介入；干预」
同源词，ad-（向）加 venire（来），义为「到来；出现」

senses.title: A wide street
senses.definition: a wide street in a town, often lined with trees
senses.definitionCN: 城市中宽阔的街道，两侧常栽有树木
senses.example: A wide avenue runs from the station to the park.
senses.exampleCN: 一条宽阔的大街从车站一直通到公园。
senses.why: Avenue comes from French avenue, a way of approach, from Latin advenire, to come to; the street sense grew from the idea of a route that leads you toward a place.
senses.whyCN: avenue 经法语 avenue「接近之路」来自拉丁语 advenire「来到」；街道义正是从「把人引向某处的通路」长出来的。

senses.title: A way to achieve something
senses.definition: a possible way of achieving something or dealing with a problem
senses.definitionCN: 达成某事或处理问题的可能方式
senses.example: The talks opened a new avenue for peace.
senses.exampleCN: 会谈为和平开辟了一条新途径。
senses.why: If a street is a route toward a place, then any route toward a result can be called an avenue, especially in formal writing about options.
senses.whyCN: 既然街道是通向某地的路线，那么通向结果的任何路线也能叫 avenue，正式文体里常用来指可选项。

intro.en: Avenue is a word about a way that leads you toward something.
intro.cn: avenue 说的是把人引向某处的一条路。

items.cn: 英语 avenue 起初指通向宅邸的道路。

items.en: It came to mean any wide city street.
items.cn: 后来泛指城市里的宽阔街道。

normalIntro.en: An avenue is a broad way in, and later any broad way to a result.
normalIntro.cn: avenue 先是宽阔的进入之路，后指通向结果的宽路。

normal.en: Think of a road wide enough for two rows of trees.
normal.cn: 想象一条宽到能栽两排树的道路。

normal.en: The plural is avenues, with the stress on the first syllable.

abstract.en: See a long straight road framed by two lines of trees.
abstract.cn: 想象一条笔直长路，两旁各有一排树。

abstract.en: See a map with one wide road cutting across many small ones.
abstract.cn: 想象地图上一条大路横穿许多小路。

abstract.en: See a door opening at the end of that road.
abstract.cn: 想象那条路的尽头有一扇门打开。

examples.en: They explored every avenue before giving up.

root: 源自拉丁语 advenire「来到」，由 ad-「向」与 venire「来」构成，经古法语 avenue「接近之路」进入英语；由通往宅邸的道路引申为城市大街与做事途径。

sensesIntro.en: A street and a route to a result share one image of a way that leads somewhere.

definition_zh: 短途旅行；远足；离题；涉猎
definition_en: a short journey made for pleasure, or a brief departure from a main subject
core_image: 当天往返的一辆郊游巴士
scene: 学校组织了一次去海边的短途旅行。 The school organized an excursion to the seaside.
sceneCN: 这里 excursion 是「短途旅行」（第 1 个义项）；句意：学校组织了一次去海边的短途旅行。

senses.title: Short trip
senses.definition: a short journey made for pleasure, usually returning the same day
senses.definitionCN: 为游乐而进行的短途出行，通常当天返回
senses.example: We took an excursion to the old town.
senses.exampleCN: 我们去老城短途游览了一趟。
senses.why: The group runs out and comes back within a day.
senses.whyCN: 一群人跑出去，当天又回来。

senses.title: Digression
senses.definition: a short period of trying an activity or leaving the main subject
senses.definitionCN: 短暂尝试某项活动，或暂时离开主题
senses.example: His lecture included an excursion into medieval music.
senses.exampleCN: 他的讲座中夹了一段对中世纪音乐的涉猎。
senses.why: The mind also runs off the main road for a while.
senses.whyCN: 思绪也会暂时跑离主路。

definition_zh: 革命的；革命性的；革命者
definition_en: relating to a revolution, or completely new
core_image: 一面新旗插在旧城墙上，颜色鲜明
scene: 这种新的电池设计具有革命性，能让手机一周不充电。 This new battery design is revolutionary and can keep a phone running for a week.
sceneCN: 这里 revolutionary 是「革命性的」（第 2 个义项：完全新颖、带来巨变）；句意：这种新的电池设计具有革命性，能让手机一周不充电。

senses.title: About revolution
senses.definition: connected with a political revolution
senses.definitionCN: 与政治革命有关的
senses.example: He joined the revolutionary army.
senses.exampleCN: 他加入了革命军。
senses.why: The suffix -ary turns revolution into an adjective.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ary 把 revolution 变成形容词。

senses.title: Completely new
senses.definition: causing a great change in a field
senses.definitionCN: 在某一领域带来巨大改变
senses.example: The new method was revolutionary for surgery.
senses.exampleCN: 这种新方法对手术来说是革命性的。
senses.why: A political break becomes a break with old methods anywhere.
senses.whyCN: 政治上的断裂延伸为对旧方法的突破。

senses.title: A person

senses.definitionCN: 参加革命的人
senses.example: The revolutionaries met in secret.
senses.exampleCN: 革命者秘密集会。
senses.why: The adjective also serves as a noun for the people involved.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词也作名词，指参与其中的人。

items.en: Revolutio names a turning around.

items.en: Revolution names a political upheaval.
items.cn: revolution 指政治剧变。

items.en: Revolution enters English as the event.

items.en: Revolutionary also means completely new.

normal.cn: 革命性变化是深刻的，而非细小的。

normal.en: Compare radical: radical goes to the root, revolutionary overturns.
normal.cn: 对比 radical：radical 触及根本，revolutionary 强调推翻。

abstract.en: Picture a bright flag on an old wall.
abstract.cn: 想象旧墙上的一面鲜亮旗帜。

abstract.en: Imagine a key that opens a door nobody knew was there.
abstract.cn: 想象一把钥匙打开一扇无人知晓的门。

abstract.en: Think of a seed splitting stone from inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗种子从内部裂开石头。

examples.en: The revolutionary movement spread quickly.
examples.cn: 革命运动迅速蔓延。

examples.en: Her design was truly revolutionary.
examples.cn: 她的设计真正具有革命性。

examples.en: The revolutionaries were arrested at dawn.
examples.cn: 革命者在黎明时被捕。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「revolution（革命）＋ ary（形容词后缀）」——与革命有关的，就是革命的、革命性的。

root: revolution（革命）＋ -ary（形容词后缀）→ revolutionary，核心义「与整圈翻转有关的」。

sensesIntro.en: Revolutionary describes political revolution, then any great change, and also names the people who make it.
sensesIntro.cn: revolutionary 先描述政治革命，再指任何巨大变化，也指参与其中的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bright new flag on an old city wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：旧城墙上一面鲜明的新旗。

branches.en: The political sense comes first.
branches.cn: 政治含义最先出现。

branches.en: Any field can have a revolutionary change.
branches.cn: 任何领域都可能有革命性变化。

branches.en: The word also names the people.
branches.cn: 这个词也指参与的人。

branches.en: Political fighters and their cause share the name.
branches.cn: 政治战士与其事业共用这个词。

branches.en: Political and technical breaks are both deep changes.
branches.cn: 政治与技术的断裂都是深刻变化。

intro.en: Revolutionary adds the adjective suffix -ary to revolution.
intro.cn: revolutionary 在 revolution 后加形容词后缀 -ary。

latinIntro.en: The base revolution comes from Latin revolutio.
latinIntro.cn: 基础词 revolution 来自拉丁语 revolutio。

latinEntries.exampleCN: volvere 是这一组词的基础。
